description: This file defines the Security interface for authorization-related methods within the Apache OFBiz framework, including permission checks, role validation, and cache clearing.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Interface for security and permission management, including methods for permission checks, role validation, and cache clearing.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve the Delegator object.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Deprecated method to set the Delegator object.

methods.name: findUserLoginSecurityGroupByUserLoginId
methods.description: Deprecated method to find security groups for a user login ID.

methods.name: securityGroupPermissionExists
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if a security group permission exists.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user (via session) or a specific user login has a given permission.

methods.name: hasEntityPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission for a specific entity and action.

methods.name: hasRolePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission for a specific role within an application, with various overloads for different parameters.

methods.name: clearUserData
methods.description: Clears cached data related to a user upon logout.
